title: Phillip Daigle - Rogue's Gate: Feeling Around in the Dark
speaker: Phillip Daigle
talk_title: Rogue's Gate: Feeling Around in the Dark
description:
This talk is from the 2020 virtual Roguelike Celebration:
https://roguelike.club/event2020.html

Phil is a 14 year veteran of the games industry, former Studio Director @ Beamdog, currently Senior Design Producer @ Improbable Canada. He describes himself as an "Insufferably positive, uneducated lout who fell ass-backwards into CRPGs."

In this talk, he showcases a roguelike he has been working on for the last few years called Rogue's Gate. Its development involved learning to program all over again, exploring the depths of Open Source Game Artwork, and designing-as-he-went with an eye towards game feel rather than mechanical finesse. He quite literally followed one of the "How to build a roguelike" guides off RogueBasin for some aspects of it. He shares what he ran into, how he handled problems with the tools he had on hand and not necessarily the ones he wanted, and how he designs from the gut.

Find him on Twitter: https://twitter.com/daigledopple
Rogue's Gate: https://daigledopple.itch.io/rogues-gate
